title: A Crown for the Veil
author: Sable Kavanagh
blurb: Mara Joubert, a royal food-taster building immunity one dish at a time, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
